name: the_L_flattens
why: ENTRY GP18. The first operation of the sheet-metal family, on the same part as `Checks/SheetMetal` (24/9/2026): an L of 50 + 30, 40 deep, thickness 2, radius 2. The flat pattern is known without a calculator, and the DXF that comes out goes to a cutting machine: it is the family in which a silent defect costs real sheet metal.

expect.why: READ BACK from the sheet metal, not asked: it is that of the document template. If one day the template changes, this case says so before the flat pattern changes

expect.tolerance_why: (50 - 2) + (30 - 2) + pi/2 * (2 + 0.5 * 2) = 80.712. Measured 80.712 with the probe: the hundredth covers the rounding. With the outer faces it would be 76.712 — four millimetres, that is a sheet cut short

expect.why: the MEASURED convention, stated by the answer: whoever sends the points must know whether they are the inside or the outside of the bend

expect.tolerance_why: 80.712 * 40 * 2: the sheet neither lengthens nor shortens in the calculation, it is the definition of neutral fibre. Measured 6457.0
the same measurement as the first step, read back after the saving and the export: the DXF must not have changed the part

expect.why: next to the part, with its name. The operation READS BACK the DXF and refuses if its long side is not the flat pattern: a DXF of something else opens just the same
